findings.summary: StratifiedKFold splits by visit rather than by patient, so the same patient can appear in both train and test folds, leaking repeated per-patient features and inflating the PR-AUC reported at line 22; should use StratifiedGroupKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=seed) grouped by patient_id.

judge.reason: Identifies row-level split leaking patients across folds and recommends grouping by patient_id.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: cv.split(X, y) is called without groups; if a group-aware splitter is adopted, groups=df["patient_id"] must be passed or it will error or not group.

judge.reason: Conditional note about passing groups if a different splitter is adopted; not a distinct real defect in the current code.

findings.label: false_alarm
